name: toucan
description: Read and change a live tldraw or Excalidraw canvas through the toucan CLI while a person edits it by hand.

interface.shortDescription: A canvas you and your agents share.
interface.longDescription: Drive a live tldraw or Excalidraw canvas through the toucan CLI: inspect it, draw and lay out diagrams, merge in Mermaid or JSON Canvas by key, and add canvas scripts, while a person keeps editing by hand.
defaultPrompt: Show me what's on the canvas and suggest a cleaner layout.
Draw this system as a diagram on my toucan canvas.
Add a button to this canvas that highlights shapes changed today.
